passages.heading: Description
passages.text: The freestream is a generic boundary condition that provides a free-stream condition. It is a mixed condition derived from the inletOutlet condition, whereby the mode of operation switches between fixed (free stream) value and zero gradient based on the sign of the flux.
passages.why: With farfield_bc set to freestream the turbulence fields use this condition (free-stream value where the flux enters, zero gradient where it leaves); velocity and pressure use the related freestreamVelocity and freestreamPressure types, which this page does not describe.

passages.heading: Usage
passages.text: The condition requires entries in both the boundary and field files.
passages.why: The outer patch is an ordinary patch in the mesh and gets type freestream with a freestreamValue in each field file.
